announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.12 — tombol LIHAT (sebelah SIMPAN) membuka galeri preset bergambar: 24 preset foto, 8 Visualization Mode dan 4 Analisis Kinerja; klik gambar = preset terpasang. Gemini kini memakai model 4 Hydrogen lebih dulu, Notasi ikut di mode Eksterior, dan Mode Cerita mudah dimatikan dari ubin GENERATE. Update terpasang otomatis saat aplikasi dibuka.
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.12 — the BROWSE button (next to SAVE) opens a picture gallery of presets: 24 photo presets, 8 Visualization Modes and 4 Performance Analyses; click a picture to apply it. Gemini now uses the 4 Hydrogen model first, Notes also work in Exterior mode, and Story Mode is easy to switch off from the GENERATE tile. The update installs automatically when the app opens.
